_what: The words tools/start-a-computer answers with (do-work/start-a-computer.mjs): each refusal says what was wrong and what to send instead. {name} is filled from the request or the run.
not_an_object: Send one JSON object: { folder, accounts, listen, public_origin, report?, router?, default_places?, trillion_local?, start? }.
unknown_field: {field} is not a field this tool takes: send only folder, accounts, listen, public_origin, report, router, default_places, access, sign_in, sign_up, new_accounts, trillion_local and start.
not_absolute: {field} must be an absolute path with no `.` or `..` parts, like /srv/place-one.
listen: listen must be an IP address and a port from 1 to 65535, like 0.0.0.0:7199 or [::]:7199 (a host name is not taken).
origin_scheme: public_origin must start with https:// (the engine takes no other scheme): send it like https://computer.example.test.
origin_bare: public_origin must be the scheme and host only, with an optional port and no path, query, user or trailing slash, like https://computer.example.test.
router: router must be host:port with a port from 1 to 65535, like router.example.test:7443.
report_field: report.{field} is not a report field: a report has storage, reach, cost_per_month_cents, contained_tools, always_on, model_pool, program_folders, takes_new_accounts and store_size.
report_storage: report.storage must be { "keep_free_bytes": N } or { "bytes": N } with N a whole number (bytes above 0).
report_value: report.{field} has the wrong kind of value: cost_per_month_cents and model_pool are whole numbers, contained_tools, always_on and takes_new_accounts are true or false, reach is text and program_folders a list of absolute folders.
object_field: {field} must be a JSON object when it is given.
default_places_shape: default_places must be { holders: [computer ids], answering: [computer ids], voters?: [computer ids] }.
default_places_list: default_places.{list} must be a list of computer ids.
default_places_holders: default_places.holders must name at least one computer and at most {most}.
default_places_id: default_places.{list} holds {value}, which is not a computer id: a computer id is 64 lowercase hex (what the engine's id command (`id_argv`) prints), or the word {this_place} for this computer.
default_places_repeat: default_places.{list} names {value} twice: name each computer once.
default_places_answering: default_places.answering names {value}, which is not among the holders: an answering computer must also hold the account.
default_places_here: default_places must name this computer ({place_id}, or the word {this_place}) among both holders and answering: a sign-up here makes the account's door here.
start: start must be true or false.
no_program: No trillion-local was found: send trillion_local, the absolute path of the engine's program, or put it on the PATH.
not_a_program: trillion_local {path} is not a file this computer can run: send the path of the engine's built trillion-local.
not_a_folder: {field} {path} is there but is not a folder: name a folder.
key_not_a_file: {path} is there but is not a file: move it, or name another folder.
id_failed: the engine's id command (`id_argv`) refused the config: {said}
id_shape: the engine's id command (`id_argv`) printed something that is not a computer id: check the trillion_local program is the engine's.
serve_stopped: `trillion-local serve` stopped right after it started (exit {code}): {said}. Its log is {log}.
